newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae to launch in-store banks Q1 97.
newsitem.headline: Sonae to launch in-store banks Q1 97.

text.p: Portugal's biggest retailer Sonae said it would open a chain of in-store banks called Banco Universo in the first quarter of 1997.
"For the first time in Portugal, it will be possible to use innovative services at a convenient hour in finance shops in Modelo and Continente hypermarkets (belonging to Sonae)," a statement said.
Portugal's second biggest retailer Jeronimo Martins has also announced plans to offer in-store banking in partnership with Banco Comercial Portugues.
The banks will be located in shopping centres and offer credit facilities to customers such as home mortgages and car loans.
